data.additional_information:
The School of Management Sciences at Chanakya University is seeking applications for faculty positions in the areas of Human Resources Management, Organizational Behaviour, Marketing, Strategy, Finance & Accounting. The role of an Assistant Professor is to engage in teaching, research, and other academic activities to contribute to the university's academic excellence and knowledge dissemination. They are responsible for nurturing students' learning, conducting research in their area of expertise, and actively participating in university service and development activities.

Responsibilities

Teaching and Curriculum Development:
• Prepare and deliver lectures, tutorials, and practical sessions to undergraduate and/or postgraduate students.
• Designing and developing course curricula that align with the NEP framework, and the objectives of the department and university. 
• Employing innovative pedagogical methods to engage students actively in the learning process.
• Provide guidance and mentorship to students, encouraging their academic and professional growth.
Research and Scholarly Activities:
• Engaging in rigorous scholarly research and publication in relevant academic areas, demonstrating a commitment to contribute to the advancement of knowledge.
• Pursuing collaborative research projects, both within the department and with other faculty members and institutions, to promote interdisciplinary research and innovation. 
• Apply for research grants and funding to support research activities.
Academic Evaluation and Assessment:
• Assisting in curriculum development, assessment, and accreditation processes 
• Design and administer assessments, examinations, and assignments to evaluate students' learning outcomes.
• Provide timely and constructive feedback to students to help them improve their academic performance.
Institution Development Activities:
• Participate in departmental and university committees, contributing to academic governance and decision-making processes.
• Engage in community service and outreach activities to promote the university's social impact. 
Professional Development:
• Pursuing continuous professional development by attending conferences, workshops, and seminars in the relevant field of expertise.
• Staying updated with advancements in teaching methodologies, research trends. 
• Attend conferences, workshops, and seminars to network and share knowledge with peers.
Mentorship and Advising:
• Act as an academic advisor to students, providing guidance on course selection, career paths, and personal development.
• Supervise and mentor research scholars and students on academic projects.
Collaboration and Networking:
• Collaborate with colleagues within and outside the university to foster interdisciplinary research and academic initiatives.
• Engage in partnerships with industry, government, and other academic institutions for research and collaboration opportunities.

Qualifications Required:

• A PhD in relevant discipline from a recognised institute of repute. 
• 1-5 years of teaching and / or relevant industry experience will be an advantage

Skills Required:

• Dedication to maintaining high academic standards and promoting a positive learning environment.
• A passion for teaching, research, and academic pursuits.
• Commitment to upholding ethical practices in research and teaching, in particular in the context of AI driven research and teaching
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Familiarity with the National Education Policy framework will be beneficial.
• Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and students from diverse backgrounds.

Reporting Relationship

• Reports to the Dean of the School
